promotion_constraints: Exact frozen baseline command ID and HTML/CSS SHA-256 must verify before candidate work begins.
Website Business remains upstream commercial/creative owner; structural composition is implementation execution only.

Structural Composition Agent may regroup existing verified content and approved assets but may not add or rewrite claims, services, destinations, imagery strategy, market positioning or brand direction.
Each candidate must show a non-trivial normalized DOM structural delta and independently demonstrate fidelity to its approved structural blueprint before CSS styling evidence counts.
A candidate that merely restyles essentially unchanged markup when its plan requires structural recomposition must fail the structure gate.
Candidate A and Candidate B remain isolated and start from the same frozen baseline; no cross-candidate code, screenshots, critique or patch reuse.
All verified facts, exact links/assets, services, business journeys, semantics, accessibility invariants and zero-external-action authority remain mandatory.
Post-structure CSS and candidate-local correction remain bounded and cannot self-approve.
Promotion still requires calibrated implementationQuality >=92, source/browser/accessibility/visual/security PASS, materially BETTER than baseline, agencyQuality=true, and final Challenger PASS.
If neither candidate qualifies, restore and retain the frozen baseline; no manual merge or rescue outside the governed loop.
Preview deployment remains a separate approval-gated action.
